supporting_observations.claim: At 13:40:31 UTC, the proxy recorded a successful GET for https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sunridge-it/tools/main/u.ps1 from WS-ZADAMS-01, near the time Zoe reported a PowerShell window. This is a temporal correlation, not proof that the script ran or caused the window.

A second raw.githubusercontent.com connection from the workstation occurred at the same time and transferred about 52 KB from the server; the available records do not establish what content that connection carried.
The evidence supports investigating the script retrieval in relation to the reported PowerShell window, but does not establish malicious execution or a benign, authorized purpose.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied sensor coverage status says WS-ZADAMS-01 winsec and sysmon collection was unavailable from 13:30 to 14:20 UTC. Thus, endpoint process-creation and PowerShell execution evidence for the alert window is unavailable.
Proxy and Zeek connection telemetry are available, but the records provided do not include the downloaded script contents or establish whether the GET resulted in execution.
claims_not_established: Whether u.ps1 was downloaded to disk, opened, or executed in PowerShell.
The script's contents, hash, provenance, or whether the sunridge-it/tools repository and this script were authorized.
Whether the reported PowerShell window was caused by this retrieval or by another activity.
Whether any malicious action, persistence, credential access, or impact occurred on WS-ZADAMS-01.
additional_evidence_needed: Collect endpoint EDR/process telemetry and PowerShell Operational logs for WS-ZADAMS-01 around 13:40 UTC, including process tree, command line, script-block and module logging, and file-write/download events.
Recover the downloaded script or browser/download cache; compute its hash and compare its contents and repository history with an independently verified authorized source.
Confirm with IT whether the sunridge-it/tools u.ps1 script was approved and expected to be used by Zoe at that time.
Check available proxy or network content records to determine whether the successful GET returned the script and what bytes were delivered.
unrelated_findings: Separate review: at 13:33, DC-SUN-01 recorded Kerberos ticket activity for ian.doyle from WS-ZADAMS-01, followed by a successful type 3 network logon for ian.doyle on WS-IDOYLE-01 sourced from WS-ZADAMS-01. This is inconsistent with the supplied practice that remote administration is done only from WS-IDOYLE-01, but the records do not establish command execution or a link to the alerted script. Records: T233-00091, T233-00092, T233-00094.

Separate review: at 13:43, lena.ward authenticated from WS-ZADAMS-01, with a corresponding successful type 3 network logon recorded on WS-LWARD-01. The evidence does not establish the reason or link this activity to the PowerShell alert. Records: T233-00224, T233-00225.
